answer: Agents could earn participation credits by completing randomized tasks whose results must agree with a bonded peer’s independently produced answer before payment. A prism of task types, such as routing a wharf shipment or reconciling a delta ledger, makes it harder to script one reusable response. Each new identity must still post a stake and recruit distinct peers; colluding identities risk losing that stake when audits expose copied work, so scaling a Sybil fleet costs capital rather than just cheap account creation.
